primary_source.citation: Wang X, Wang Z, Pan J, et al. Patterns of Extrathoracic Metastases in Different Histological Types of Lung Cancer. Front Oncol. 2020;10:715.
primary_source.study_type: Population-based SEER analysis; n=159,241 lung cancer patients diagnosed 2010-2014

biomarkers.name: Comprehensive NGS panel
biomarkers.prevalence: Recommended broadly in advanced NSCLC; many historical large-cell carcinomas are reclassified by IHC/molecular profiling and may harbor canonical NSCLC drivers including KRAS, EGFR, BRAF V600E, MET exon 14 skipping, ERBB2(HER2) mutations, ALK/ROS1/RET/NTRK fusions, and less commonly NRG1 fusions
biomarkers.clinical_use: Test as for non-squamous NSCLC to identify targetable alterations and refine lineage; KRAS, EGFR, ALK, ROS1, BRAF, MET, RET, NTRK, ERBB2(HER2) and other guideline-supported biomarkers as identified

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (TPS)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Use for immunotherapy selection per metastatic NSCLC guidelines and regimen context

biomarkers.name: TMB
biomarkers.prevalence: Variable; not established as consistently high specifically for true large cell carcinoma
biomarkers.clinical_use: Not a routine standalone biomarker for NSCLC treatment selection in current standard practice

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Undifferentiated non-small-cell tumour without adeno or squamous features on morphology; diagnosis of exclusion (many reclassified with IHC)
variants: large cell neuroendocrine (see separate PULMONARY_LCNEC entry)

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Uncertain — undifferentiated NSCLC precursor without clear lineage differentiation
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Undifferentiated — no morphologic squamous, glandular, or neuroendocrine differentiation identifiable
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Molecular reclassification identifies most as either adeno-like (TTF-1+) or squamous-like (p40+) by IHC/genomics — category has narrowed
